payload.body_they: {{Name}} often discovers what they think by talking, writing, asking questions, or hearing themselves explain something out loud. Because their thinking is easy to see, something they say while figuring things out can quickly become part of how other people define them. They are allowed to know more now than they knew when they first described the plan. Their language should be able to change when their thinking does.
